name: runsheet-mcp
description: Runsheet's local MCP server, for the YouTube autopilot. Uploads videos from your own machine straight to YouTube and schedules them, and forwards the rest of Runsheet's YouTube toolkit to Claude, Cursor or any MCP client.
author: Kalpesh Mahida

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('runsheet-mcp: plain Node, nothing to build')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const r=(f)=>require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(13)).join('');if(r('src/index.mjs')!==r('plugins/runsheet/server/index.mjs'))throw new Error('The plugin runs its own copy of the server: copy src/index.mjs to plugins/runsheet/server/index.mjs and bump the plugin version.')"
